records.part: Magnetic Imaging Tool - DOWEL - Scan (magnetic imaging tool for measuring dowel and tie bar alignments in concrete pavement)
records.reason: The KSE Testing Equipment (KSE) is the sole distributor for MIT Magnetic Tomography NDT equipment in the USA. As such, KSE is the only vendor that can install, configure, and calibrate the hardware and software required to operate the MIT SCAN.
